src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2022_us_cd118_500k
cd.vint: The Census Bureau's lines of the 118th Congress's districts (its file says session 118).
rec: Court-record joint stipulation, Alpha Phi Alpha v. Raffensperger, No. 1:21-cv-5337 (N.D. Ga., Doc. 94, Feb. 4, 2022): 2021 plans passed Nov. 12, 2021; signed Dec. 30, 2021; earlier 2014 Senate and 2015 House plans (copy hosted by Loyola Law School)

Signed by Gov. Kemp on Dec. 30, 2021 with the Senate and House maps; challenged in Alpha Phi Alpha v. Raffensperger and companion cases (injunction denied before the 2022 elections). Census file basis: the Bureau documents its 2022 legislative files as the plans collected for the 2022 election year, and the 118th Congress files as the plans the states submitted for that Congress. Compared on documents only: the cached Census folder held only the 2024 vintage when this was checked, so the 2020 and 2022 files were not opened.
